name: Chuurinjou
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood bicycle parking lot (Tometome Chuurinjou): a notice about the parking fee changing, a first day working part-time at the lot, a price-and-rules guide, an online commuter-pass application starting, a comparison of new-staff training plans, a lesson learned about customer-focused response, teaching a new part-timer how to line up bicycles properly, an essay on why abandoned-bicycle removal started, a free giveaway event for unclaimed bicycles, a column on how online applications changed the daily flow, a new year-end rule standard, a reflection on the meaning of a veteran staff member's skill at reading parking patterns, and a one-year cooperation report with a local abandoned-bicycle council. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
